searchMetadata.description: Information about the search results page

query.description: The keyword/search term that produced this results page

searchUrl.description: URL of the current search results page

totalResults.description: Total number of results reported by the page (when displayed)

products.description: List of product cards visible on the search results page. Each card carries the data shown directly in the listing — no follow-up to product detail pages.

url.description: Absolute URL to the product detail page (must include protocol and domain)

productId.description: Unique identifier for the product (e.g., ASIN, SKU, item_id) — extract if visible in the URL or markup

name.description: Product name / title as displayed on the search card

price.description: Current price of the product as a number (no currency symbol). Use the visible card price, not strikethrough/list price.

currency.description: Currency code or symbol associated with `price` (e.g. "USD", "$", "R$")

originalPrice.description: Original / pre-discount price when the card shows a strikethrough or 'was' price

image.description: Absolute URL of the primary product image displayed on the card

rating.description: Average customer rating as a number (e.g. 4.5)

reviewsCount.description: Number of customer reviews displayed alongside the rating

availability.description: Stock / availability hint shown on the card (e.g. 'In stock', 'Only 2 left', 'Out of stock')

sponsored.description: Whether the card is marked as sponsored / ad / promoted

pagination.description: Pagination information used to walk additional pages of results

totalPages.description: Total number of pages available for this search

hasNextPage.description: Whether there is a next page available

nextPageUrl.description: Absolute URL to the next page of results (must include protocol and domain)
